title: Page 5
slug: 捡夫宝娘子-金妍-戚家四兄弟只剩他戚无双这个当家老大还未娶妻-看弟弟们恩爱成双加上每天被媒婆们当大肥羊紧盯著-他烦不胜烦
content_zh:
“贵叔为什么不肯走？”
“听说宝老爷对他有救命之恩，他为了报恩才愿意留下来。”
“那宝康现在人呢？”他微微皱眉，自己住在宝家的这半个月来，可从不曾见过这号人物，宝安儿他们也没提起过。
“大概半年前，听说宝康终于决定好好的振作起来，希望能够重振宝家，便将宝家剩余的家产变卖，只留下宝家大宅，出外经商去了，但他却一去不复返，全无消息，宝安儿只好想办法养活自己，开始在外头抛头露面卖包子。”
戚无双的眸光一黯，心口莫名感到刺痛，颇为心疼她的处境，也担心宝康恐怕还是不知悔改，迟早会把最后的家产给败掉的。
而她呢？她到底知不知道自己可能早已被哥哥弃之不理，还是依旧天真地一位哥哥总有一天会衣锦荣归，让宝家再现过往繁荣？
“你对宝安儿这个人了解多少？”
“哦，她可有趣了，在宝家还没衰败之前，她是个心肠极好的姑娘，经常救济穷困，但当宝家衰败之后，她就变成了一个斤斤计较的女人，但这是情有可原的，毕竟如果不这么做，在已无亲人的庇荫之下，她一个弱女子想独自生活下去，也是满困难的。”
所以她变得斤斤计较是不得已的，内心却还是很善良，就算知道自己没有能力帮助人，但还是忍不住心软救了他……
这下子，他更想知道真正的宝安儿到底是什么模样，对她的兴趣也越来越浓厚……
戚无双从周掌柜口中知道所有宝家的事后，便离开无戚钱庄，朝宣河县最热闹的市集街上走去。
他想知道，曾经是个千金大小姐的宝安儿，现在却沦落到在街上卖包子，她真的忍受得了这样的委屈及难堪吗？
来到市集上，戚无双顺利找到宝安儿卖肉包的小摊子，他故意躲在角落，偷偷地观察她。
她站在摊子后头，认真地对来往行人叫卖，不过生意显然并不好，倒是一旁好几个小乞儿一直瞧着她的摊子，拼命吞口水，一副饿坏的模样。
宝安儿没有注意到戚无双，反倒被一旁直盯着她吞口水的小乞儿们给瞧得非常不自在，柳眉皱了又松、松了又皱，像是陷在挣扎中，一脸为难。
就这样犹豫挣扎了好一会儿之后，她轻叹了口气，终于下定决心，
“过来呀。”她向一旁的小乞儿招招手。
小乞儿眼睛一亮，瞬间跑到她面前，赶紧伸出脏兮兮的小手，就怕抢不到肉包子吃。
“别急别抢，每个人都有。”她将肉包一个个放在小乞儿手中后，便板着脸催促他们离开。“快点走吧，别再来找我，下次我可不会再给你们包子吃了！”
小乞儿们拿到肉包子后，便咬着离开摊子了。

在他们跑远之后，宝安儿故意板起的脸才松下，随即扬起一抹纯真、温柔的微笑，静静地目送他们离开。
这一刻，戚无双的心猛然震了一下，被她那不曾在他面前显露过的温柔微笑给深深吸引住，完全移不开视线。
她看起来很满足、很欣慰、很快乐，和刚才的凶巴巴简直是判若两人，如果不是亲眼所见，他也不会相信，原来她的凶都是装出来的。她的笑容很美，并不只是外在样貌的美，还有发自内心的善良之美，这种美温柔、内敛，却能够萦绕在人们的心房，触动内心深处的感动，并且久久无法忘怀。
这才是真正的她？他的心有着前所未有的悸动，为了她这一抹柔美的笑容而失神，对她的观感也在这一刻彻底改变。
他很确定，她是个善良心软的好姑娘，就算她被残酷的现实逼得非得斤斤计较不可，但她的内心深处还是保有温柔善良，怀着恻隐之心，让她在挣扎之后还是选择伸出手，帮助他、帮助那群小乞儿……
宝安儿在等到小乞儿的身影都消失在大街上之后，才收回自己的视线及笑容，不经意瞄到对面似乎有个眼熟的男子，她讶异地张大眼，还以为是不是看错了。
“吴双？”他不是该要忙着找份工作好挣钱？
既然被发现了，戚无双干脆正大光明地来到她面前，压抑下此刻激荡的悸动情怀，一脸笑容。
“宝小姐，我应该没打扰到你吧？”他真的很庆幸，自己一时兴起过来一趟，要不然或许他永远不会发现她深藏住的温柔笑靥，也不会知道她的心其实很软，根本就是个好心的姑娘。
或许他一刚开始只是对她矛盾的言行态度感到好奇，所以才会对她有兴趣，但此时此刻，他非常确定，自己被她隐藏在表面下的那颗善良真心所吸引，对她……有了更多不一样的感觉。
“你……怎么了？笑得这么诡异？”宝安儿狐疑地瞧着他。
自从被他给杀下二两又五十文钱的欠债，惊觉他不是个简单好欺负的人之后，她就告诫自己不可以再被他的笑容给迷惑，认定他的笑不怀好意，但现下却又觉得他此刻的表情跟之前不太一样，但哪儿不一样却又说不上来。
好像是……多了那么一点点柔情，但有可能吗？会不会是她看错了……
他不在意她的扫兴话语，径自转移话题。“贵叔呢？怎么不见他？”他记得他们俩是一起顾摊的。
“他去帮我买做包子要用的材料，所以暂时由我一个人顾摊子。”她抛开内心荒谬的想法，觉得肯定是自己看错了。
“对了，我还没吃过你的包子，不知道你的手艺好不好？”
“你想都别想。”她赶紧捍卫自己辛苦做出的包子。“这可是得卖钱的。”
“看来你对小乞儿比较好。”他故意皱了皱眉，装得有些受伤。“原来在你的眼中，我比那些小乞儿还不如。”
“你……”她没好气地瞪了他一眼。“无赖，我早该明白，你的脸皮就是这么厚。”
嘴巴念是这么念，宝安儿还是从蒸笼里拿出一颗肉包子，用油纸包着递到他面前，拿他没辙。

戚无双哪是真的想吃什么包子，只是故意要逗弄她，想看她气呼呼又拿他没奈何的表情，真实很有趣。
但当他咬下第一口之后，眸光顿时一亮，意外地惊喜。
包子里的肉没有腥味，反倒有一股说不出的鲜味弥漫在嘴里，就像是用上等肉质制作出来的包子，卖相普通，但滋味却是一等一的好。
他这些年来也尝过不少山珍海味，已经很少有东西能让他觉得美味无比，但手中的这颗肉包子却让他忍不住赞叹，没想到包子也可以如此美味。
“怎样，好吃吗？”宝安儿一双眼睛期待地闪呀闪。
“很好吃。”他毫不吝啬地给予肯定。
“那就好。”她得意地扬起嘴角。“我就知道我的手艺没问题的，保管你吃一次就会上瘾。”
“你怎么会做这种肉包子？”他真是小看她了。
“我们家之前有个手艺很好的厨子，我很喜欢厨子做的包子，一时兴起就请他教我，没想到这会儿倒是被我拿来谋生了。”
她指指包子馅中绿色的菜末。“其实我用的只是中等的猪肉，但这一味香料却有提鲜的效果，这就是厨子教我肉包子要好吃的诀窍。”
她也是因为要摘这一味鲜少人知道的独特香料，才会跑到林子里去，因此发现落难的他，一时心软将他救回。
content_en:
"Why doesn't your uncle want to leave?"
"I heard that Mr. Bao saved his life, and he was willing to stay in order to repay his kindness."
"What about Baokang now?" He frowned slightly. In the half month he had lived in Bao's house, he had never seen this person before, and Bao An'er and the others had never mentioned it.
"About half a year ago, I heard that Baokang finally decided to cheer up, hoping to revive the Bao family, so he sold the rest of the Bao family's property, leaving only the Bao family mansion, and went out to do business, but he never came back, and there was no news. Bao An'er had to find a way to support himself and started to show his face outside selling steamed buns."
Qi Wushuang's eyes darkened, and she felt an inexplicable sting in her heart. She felt sorry for her situation, and worried that Baokang might still be unrepentant and sooner or later lose the last piece of his family fortune.
And what about her? Does she know that she may have been abandoned by her brother a long time ago, or is she still naive that her brother will one day return in glory and make the Bao family prosperous again?
"How much do you know about Bao An'er?"
"Oh, she's interesting. Before the Bao family declined, she was a kind-hearted girl who often helped the poor. But after the Bao family declined, she turned into a carefree woman. But this is understandable. After all, if she didn't do this, it would be very difficult for a weak woman like her to live alone without the protection of her relatives."
So she had no choice but to become careless, but she was still very kind at heart. Even though she knew she was incapable of helping others, she still couldn't help but be soft-hearted and saved him...
Now, he wanted to know what the real Bao An'er looked like, and his interest in her became more and more intense...
After Qi Wushuang learned all about the Bao family from Shopkeeper Zhou, he left Wuqi Bank and walked towards the busiest market street in Xuanhe County.
He wanted to know that Bao An'er, who was once a wealthy young lady, was now reduced to selling steamed buns on the street. Can she really endure such grievances and embarrassment?
When he came to the market, Qi Wushuang successfully found Bao An'er's small stall selling meat buns. He deliberately hid in a corner and observed her secretly.
She stood behind the stall and hawked to the passers-by seriously, but the business was obviously not very good, but there were several little beggars on the side who kept looking at her stall, swallowing hard, looking like they were starving.
Bao An'er didn't notice Qi Wushuang. Instead, she was made very uncomfortable by the little beggars who were staring at her and swallowing her saliva. Her eyebrows were wrinkled, loosened, and wrinkled again, as if she was stuck in a struggle, with a look of embarrassment on her face.
After hesitating and struggling like this for a while, she sighed softly and finally made up her mind.
"Come here." She waved to the little beggar beside her.
The little beggar's eyes lit up and he ran in front of her in an instant. He quickly stretched out his dirty little hands, fearing that he would not be able to grab the meat buns.
"Don't rush, don't grab it, everyone has it." After putting the meat buns in the hands of the little beggars one by one, she urged them to leave with a straight face. "Hurry up and don't come to me again. I won't give you buns next time!"
After the little beggars got the meat buns, they bit into them and left the stall.
After they ran away, Bao An'er's deliberately serious face relaxed, and then she raised an innocent and gentle smile and watched them leave quietly.
At this moment, Qi Wushuang's heart suddenly trembled, and he was deeply attracted by her gentle smile that had never been shown in front of him before, and he couldn't move his eyes away at all.
She looked very satisfied, gratified, and happy. She was completely different from the fierce Baba just now. If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he wouldn't have believed it. It turned out that her fierceness was all fake. Her smile is beautiful, not only the beauty of her appearance, but also the beauty of kindness that comes from her heart. This kind of beauty is gentle and restrained, but it can linger in people's hearts, touch deep feelings in their hearts, and be unforgettable for a long time.
Is this the real her? His heart hasHe was throbbing like never before, lost in thought because of her soft smile, and his perception of her completely changed at this moment.
He was sure that she was a good girl with a kind heart and a soft heart. Even if she was forced to be careless by the cruel reality, she still retained gentleness and kindness deep in her heart. With a heart of compassion, she still chose to reach out to help him and those little beggars after struggling...
Bao An'er waited until the figures of the little beggars disappeared on the street before she withdrew her gaze and smile. She inadvertently glanced at a familiar man on the opposite side. She opened her eyes in surprise, wondering if she had seen it wrong.
"Wu Shuang?" Shouldn't he be busy looking for a job to make money?
Now that he was discovered, Qi Wushuang simply came to her openly, suppressing the throbbing emotions at the moment, and smiled on his face.
"Miss Bao, I didn't disturb you, right?" He was really glad that he came here on a whim, otherwise he might never have discovered her hidden gentle smile, nor would he have known that her heart was actually very soft and that she was a kind-hearted girl.
Maybe he was just curious about her contradictory attitude in words and deeds at the beginning, so he was interested in her, but at this moment, he was very sure that he was attracted by her kind and sincere heart hidden under the surface, and he had more different feelings about her...
"What's wrong with you? Are you smiling so weirdly?" Bao An'er looked at him suspiciously.
Ever since she was charged with a debt of twenty taels and fifty cents by him, she was shocked to realize that he was not an easy person to bully. She warned herself not to be fooled by his smile anymore, and believed that his smile had bad intentions. But now she felt that his expression at this moment was different from before, but she couldn't tell what was different.
It seems like...a little more tenderness, but is it possible? Could it be that she saw it wrong...
He didn't care about her disappointing words and just changed the subject. "Where's Uncle Gui? Why don't you see him?" He remembered that the two of them were working at the stall together.
"He went to help me buy the materials for making steamed buns, so I will take care of the stall by myself for the time being." She put aside the ridiculous thoughts in her heart and felt that she must have been wrong.
"By the way, I haven't eaten your steamed buns yet. I wonder if your cooking is good?"
"Don't even think about it." She quickly defended the buns she had worked so hard to make. "This has to be sold for money."
"It seems you are kinder to the little beggar." He frowned deliberately, pretending to be a little hurt. "It turns out that in your eyes, I am worse than those little beggars."
"You..." She glared at him angrily. "Scoundrel, I should have understood earlier that you are so thick-skinned."
Even though he was saying this, Bao An'er still took out a meat bun from the steamer, wrapped it in oil paper and handed it to him. There was nothing he could do with it.
Qi Wushuang didn't really want to eat any steamed buns, he just wanted to tease her deliberately, wanting to see her angry and helpless expression on his face. It was really interesting.
But when he took the first bite, his eyes suddenly lit up and he was pleasantly surprised.
The meat in the buns has no fishy smell, but instead has an indescribable umami flavor that fills your mouth. It's like a bun made from high-quality meat. It looks ordinary, but the taste is first-class.
He has tasted a lot of delicacies from the mountains and seas over the years, and there are very few things that can make him feel extremely delicious. But the meat bun in his hand made him couldn't help but admire it. He didn't expect that the bun could be so delicious.
"How is it? Is it delicious?" Bao An'er's eyes flashed expectantly.
"It's delicious." He affirmed without hesitation.
"That's good." She raised her lips proudly. "I knew my craftsmanship was fine. If you eat it once, you will become addicted."
"How do you know how to make meat buns like this?" He really underestimated her.
"There used to be a very skilled cook in our family, and I really liked the steamed buns made by the cook. On a whim, II asked him to teach me, but I didn’t expect that now I would use it to make a living. "
She pointed to the green vegetable bits in the bun filling. “Actually, I only used medium-quality pork, but this spice has a freshness effect. This is the secret the chef taught me to make the meat buns delicious. "
It was because she wanted to pick this unique spice that few people knew that she ran into the woods. When she found him in trouble, she temporarily relented and rescued him.
